# graviteeam_domain_metadata (Data Source)

Reads Gravitee AM domain metadata such as active password policy and certificate public keys

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graviteeam_domain_metadata" "active_password_policy" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  kind      = "active_password_policy"
}

data "graviteeam_domain_metadata" "certificate_keys" {
  domain_id      = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  kind           = "certificate_keys"
  certificate_id = graviteeam_certificate.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain
- `kind` (String) Metadata kind. Supported values: active_password_policy, certificate_key, certificate_keys

### Optional

- `certificate_id` (String) Certificate ID, required for certificate_key and certificate_keys

### Read-Only

- `result_json` (String) JSON string containing the domain metadata response
